change_points.method: PELT (mean/variance, BIC penalty) on the standardised return cross-product

descriptions.rate_shock_+200bp: Parallel +200bp nominal yield shock over 12 months
descriptions.inflation_shock: Cumulative +10% CPI over 24 months (real erosion of nominal assets)
descriptions.2022_like: Equity -20% and +250bp yields over 12 months (positive stock-bond correlation)
descriptions.recession_rally: Equity -35% with -150bp yields (bond rally) over 12 months

stress.note: Synthetic, model-generated counterfactual shocks layered on matched bootstrap paths; they are not historical observations. Bond shocks use -modified duration x dy; inflation shocks reduce the real return of every nominal asset by the extra monthly CPI.

cohorts.caveat: consecutive cohorts overlap by 29 of 30 years and are not independent

warnings: model_generated: some return series are repriced from public yields (not observed total returns)
